title: A role attempt refused at the close's findings gate is never torn down
body: When closeRoleTick refuses (untriaged findings), processRoleJob returns the refusal without calling disposeRefused, so a refused review attempt leaves a live credential file, a registered worktree and a branch behind — and with tick 80x's fix the resume never adopts that attempt, so nothing will ever come back for them. disposeRefused's own comment says the gate's refusals were meant to be in its set; this one branch was missed. tearDownSettled-style cleanup on the resume (marker rebuilt from the attempts store) would fit, but the teardown is a change 80x did not ask for and so was not made here.
